canon_ref.note: Ivolethe says the storm will last two or three days.

b4.reynold_reports_lakens_convoy.summary: On the street after the Mages' Guild, Reynold tells Ryoka what Laken has done in Invrisil: he has paid for a load of food and goods and hired two adventurer teams to guard it. Ivolethe warns that a blizzard is coming and will peak by nightfall.

canon_ref.note: The Maid is not named. The ring is a disguise item. Magnolia is watching Laken.

b4.ryoka_unmasks_one_of_magnolias_maids.summary: Ivolethe points out an old man who is following them. When Ryoka calls him out, he twists a ring and turns back into one of Magnolia's [Maids] in disguise. She shows Ryoka to the inn where Laken is staying.

canon_ref.note: The Crag Pig is a rough inn with a tusked skull over the door. Frostwing is about the size of a chicken.

b4.ryoka_meets_frostwing_and_arms_durene.summary: Durene blocks the door of the Crag Pig until Ryoka gives her one of Octavia's pepper potions and tells her to carry gear. Inside, Ryoka meets Frostwing, now a big blue nestling, and plays Laken a Pokemon tune on her phone.

canon_ref.note: Ryoka is 21, Laken 24, Erin 20 (their words). Ivolethe buries the ground floor in snow to drive off listeners. The notes: greenhouses, heavy plough, crop rotation, walls, siege engines, water mills. Ryoka records Laken on her phone.

b4.laken_tells_ryoka_he_is_an_emperor.summary: Alone, Ryoka and Laken swap ages and pasts. In German he tells her he is an [Emperor]. She tells him about Erin, Magnolia, the Antinium and a summoning in Rhir, writes him notes on farming and defence, and talks him into making Ivolethe an archduchess.

b4.laken_speaks_to_wistram_by_phone.rumor: Wistram's mages say a strange voice spoke to them through an artifact and asked them to shout a message to the whole world.

canon_ref.note: They tell [BlackMage] to use only the chat from now on. Wistram learns two more Earthers exist, not where. Laken warns that some arrivals may be dangerous.

b4.laken_speaks_to_wistram_by_phone.summary: [BlackMage] rings Ryoka from Wistram with mages listening and invites her there. She swears at him for the risk. Laken takes the phone and asks that Wistram send a call home in many languages and help anyone who can prove they came from Earth.

canon_ref.note: The gear is to be ready the next day; no chapter in this batch shows the pickup. Ryoka plans to lie to the Horns about the wand.

b4.ryoka_trades_the_wand_to_hedault.summary: Ryoka sells the Horns' wand to Hedault, not for gold but for gear: armour, a sword, wands, a robe, a spellbook, rings, 200 gold and a written debt owed to the Horns of Hammerad. Ivolethe says the wand's core is a seed of an ancient tree.

canon_ref.note: Riverfarm is a one-day run for the best Runners. Reynold is told to drive Ryoka only to Liscor. The Rudolph plan starts here.

b4.laken_asks_ryoka_to_run_to_riverfarm.summary: At the Runners' Guild a [Weather Mage] says feet more snow will fall and no convoy can leave for a week. Laken asks Ryoka to run a bag of holding full of food and presents to Riverfarm before Christmas.
